title: Editor Browser Live Backend Smoke Checklist

items.label: Capture current Project Control, Core, Editor, and Backend heads, working agreements, browser-test surfaces, and prior live harness evidence before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Exact commit IDs, clean git status, AGENTS.md boundaries, prior Node live harness evidence, and browser smoke candidates are reviewed.

items.label: Confirm the browser smoke belongs in Editor without moving Backend server behavior, Core semantics, or Project Control truth responsibilities.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor app/test surfaces, Backend HTTP server surfaces, and Core fixture/adapter boundaries show the smoke can use public or test-only harness surfaces without ownership drift.

items.label: Write an Editor-owned failing browser smoke for the rendered app plus live Backend URL.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor browser smoke fails before implementation because the app does not yet expose or bind the accepted live browser path.

items.label: Implement the minimal test or app wiring needed for the browser-visible live Backend/Core path, or record a boundary blocker if product UI is missing.
items.evidenceTarget: The Editor diff keeps production responsibility boundaries intact and distinguishes browser-visible evidence from Node-only harness evidence.

items.label: Run focused and full owner repository gates after the browser smoke is in place or after the blocker is recorded.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor focused browser smoke, Editor npm run check, and any required Backend/Core no-change evidence are recorded.

items.label: Register the browser smoke evidence or blocker in Project Control without promoting broad FlowDoc truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-2026-08-27 records the commit, checks, supported claim or blocker, risks, and intentionally unpromoted truth.
